name: fluidmark
description: Watermarking for music: embed an identifier in a track and recover it from the marked file

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:core && npm run test:native && npm run test:js
scripts.docker:run: docker build -t fluidmark:local . && docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 fluidmark:local
scripts.docker:check: docker build -t fluidmark:local . && node www/browser-check.js http://127.0.0.1:8080
